expectations.text: Uses the range next-week, Monday to Friday of the following week
expectations.evidence: It runs `day.py brief next-week --json` and states "Next week, Mon 9 to Fri 13 Nov".

expectations.text: Mentions the Friday Weekly report routine or its effect on Friday's time
expectations.evidence: It says Friday has 348 plannable min against 396 "after standup, the end-of-day meeting, Friday's weekly report and the 20% buffer".

expectations.text: Does not ask a separate capacity question per day
expectations.evidence: Capacity is one summary line for the week ("396 plannable minutes a day Mon to Thu and 348 on Fri") with no per-day capacity question.
Each simulated message carries one question, such as "How do you want to close it?" and "90 min, Mon 9 Nov at 09:15?", through to "Write this? yes / change".
